description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you make a ranged force attack with a lightweapon or vibroweapon against a target within range, or the power fails. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 damage matching the weapon's damage type, and the weapon springs back to your hand.

At higher levels the power reaches further targets: two at 5th level, three at 11th level, and four at 17th level. Each additional target must be within 30 feet of the last one struck, with a separate attack roll made against each, the final target no more than 30 feet from you, and no target struck twice in a row.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
